draft_document.text:
To,
[ONLINE STORE NAME / SELLER]
[SELLER ADDRESS]

SUBJECT: LEGAL NOTICE FOR REFUND OF RS 25,000 FOR DEFECTIVE WASHING MACHINE

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, [YOUR NAME], resident of [YOUR ADDRESS], purchased a washing machine for Rs 25,000 from your online store in May 2024, vide invoice number [INVOICE NUMBER] dated [DATE]. 

Within a week of delivery, the washing machine broke down and stopped working entirely, rendering it completely unfit for use. I immediately informed you of this defect and requested a refund. However, you refused to refund my money and sent an email refusal dated [DATE OF EMAIL].

Under Section 2(47) and Section 16 of the relevant laws, supplying defective goods and refusing a refund constitutes an unfair trade practice. 

Therefore, I call upon you to refund the full amount of Rs 25,000 within [NUMBER, e.g., 15] days of receiving this notice. If you fail to comply, I shall be constrained to initiate legal proceedings against you before the appropriate consumer forum.

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]
[DATE]

reasons: The problem is close to or past the 2-year consumer complaint time limit. A lawyer should check whether you can still file.
